card.name: Fractions and percentages in dose calculations
card.fires_on: The word "of" (or "the", "%") right after a fraction, percentage or multiplier, as in "40% of the excess" or "twice the q12h dose", in dose-calculation instructions.

modes.label: Of after a fraction
modes.description: "of" follows a percentage or fraction and points to a reference amount to be scaled.
modes.example: one-eighth<< of>> the initial dose should be given after each

modes.label: Percent sign or multiplier
modes.description: The % sign or "the" after a multiplier, before the quantity being scaled.
modes.example: Women - 0.85 x<< the>> value calculated for men.

modes.label: Dose timing reference
modes.description: "last" or "after" just before "dose" in timing statements.
modes.example: for 3 months after the<< last>> dose of ELLENCE.
